title: 思い出を売ってパンケーキ！〜記憶市場の案内人と、忘れっぽすぎる君〜
author: 春宮こより

en.title: Selling Memories for Pancakes! ~The Memory Market Guide and the Boy Who Forgot Everything~
en.premise: For me, a high school girl whose sole purpose in life is eating, a strange turn of events leads me into a mysterious market where memories can be traded for money or wishes. There, I meet an incredibly airheaded hottie who sold every single memory of his first love just to repair a family heirloom—a broken sword. While exasperated by how clumsy he's become since losing his memories, I decide to fight back by overwriting his mind with 'delicious memories' to make him fall for me all over again.

zh.title: 用回忆换煎饼！〜记忆市场的引导员与健忘的你〜
zh.premise: 对我这个以吃为生的女高中生来说，某天因为一次偶然，我误入了那个“可以用记忆换取金钱或实现愿望”的市场。在那里，我遇到了一位超级天然的帅哥，他为了修复家传的“断剑”，竟然卖掉了全部关于初恋的记忆。看着失去记忆后变得笨手笨脚的他，我虽然感到无奈，但还是决定用“美味的回忆”覆盖他的记忆，努力让他再次爱上我。
